name: speko
description: AI phone calls, an AI receptionist and natural speech synthesis on one account. Call any business or person in the US or abroad from a number that is yours, so they see it and can call back; every call comes back with a transcript, recording, and summary. Set up a receptionist that answers your business line, takes messages and booking requests, and sends you a summary after every call. Turn any text into spoken audio in 100+ voices, and hear a voice or a greeting before it goes on a call. Also transcribes audio files under various languages.
